Black holes come in different sizes. The smallest are called **stellar black holes**, formed from the collapse of massive stars. There are also **intermediate-mass black holes**, which are larger, and **supermassive black holes**, which are found at the centers of most galaxies, including our own. The supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way is called **Sagittarius A***.
